facts.note: Temple bell strikes nine, everyone shows watches, Félix's watch reads twenty minutes to nine, and Aurèle scolds him. The transcript states all of this.
Piquet with the doctor in the salon without a break, temple strikes ten during play, play continues until he goes out for cigars, and she did not look at the clock when he left. All stated.
He asks her to play for him as he goes out, she sits at the piano at once and plays until he returns, and she stops when he comes in. All stated.
A moment after he returns, the hall clock strikes eleven. Stated as written.

added.quote: Aurèle scolded him for it, in front of Monsieur Girard and the doctor.
added.why: Places Monsieur Girard and the doctor at the table at the nine o'clock watch-check, a whereabouts at a moment the fact sheet does not account for. The sheet never mentions Girard at all.
